findings.title: Deleting cache does not refresh connectedCalendars, so the UI keeps showing stale cache status
findings.body: `deleteCacheMutation` only shows a toast and calls `onSuccess?.()`. It never invalidates `utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`. The `disconnectMutation` in the same file does invalidate it in `onSettled`. `onSuccess` is the optional `onChanged` prop, and the wrapper passes whatever the parent gave it, which may be undefined. After a successful delete, `cacheUpdatedAt` stays cached, so the dropdown still shows the old "Last updated" timestamp and still offers "Delete cached data". The test plan expects "UI updates appropriately", which this does not do. Invalidate the query in the delete mutation.

findings.title: Cache timestamp formatted with hard-coded en-US locale
findings.body: `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...)` ignores the user's locale and the app's i18n setting. Non-English users see US-style dates (M/D/YY) inside an otherwise translated string. Use the user's locale (for example `i18n.language`) or the existing date-formatting helpers.

findings.title: Authorization failure throws a plain Error instead of TRPCError
findings.body: When the credential is missing or belongs to another user, the handler throws `new Error(...)`. tRPC maps this to a generic 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR and it gets logged as a server error. Use `TRPCError` with `NOT_FOUND` or `FORBIDDEN`, as other handlers do. Negative in-memory delegation credential IDs also fall into this branch and will surface as 500s. The input schema in `_router.tsx` is also an inline `z.number()`, with no `.int()` and no separate schema file like the sibling procedures.

findings.title: Backfill with NOW() makes all legacy cache rows report the migration time as last updated; header comment is wrong
findings.body: Every pre-existing `CalendarCache` row gets `updatedAt = <migration time>`. The new UI will then show "Last updated" as the deploy time for entries that may be weeks old, which is misleading. Backfilling from an existing signal such as `expiresAt - 30 days` would be more accurate. The warning at the top of the file (lines 1-6) says the column was added "without a default value" and "is not possible if the table is not empty". That contradicts the statement below it, which adds a default. It is leftover auto-generated text and should be removed.

findings.title: Extra unconditional updateMany on every cache refresh with empty data
findings.body: `SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {})` now runs after every `fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache`, which is called from the webhook path. It relies on Prisma implicitly bumping `@updatedAt` for an empty update, and it rewrites every SelectedCalendar row of the credential, including event-type-level rows. It runs even when no calendars were processed. The PR notes admit the UI does not use `SelectedCalendar.updatedAt` (it uses `CalendarCache.updatedAt`), so this is a pure extra write on a hot path. Drop it, or restrict it to a real requirement.

findings.title: Unrelated change: dev:cron now relies on undeclared tsx via npx
findings.body: Switching `dev:cron` from `ts-node` to `npx tsx` is unrelated to calendar cache. `tsx` is not declared in any dependency list, so `npx` downloads it at run time, unpinned and unreproducible. Other scripts in this file still use `ts-node`. Either keep `ts-node` or add `tsx` as a devDependency, and ideally put the change in a separate PR.

findings.title: Unrelated, macOS-only helper script added; breaks on Linux and exits 0 on failure
findings.body: The script is not wired into anything and is unrelated to this feature. `sed -i '' -E ...` is BSD/macOS syntax; with GNU sed the empty string is parsed as the script and the real expression as a filename, so the .env update fails on Linux. `ENV_FILE="../.env"` depends on the caller's cwd. `cleanup` always does `exit 0`, so the rate-limit and failed-URL paths report success. It also silently rewrites `.env`. Remove it from this PR or make it portable and correct.

findings.title: Empty fixed-width wrapper rendered when dropdown has nothing to show
findings.body: The old code only rendered the `<div className="flex w-32 justify-end">` when the credential could be disconnected. Now the wrapper is always rendered, but `CredentialActionsDropdown` returns `null` for delegation or read-only credentials with no cache. This leaves an empty 8rem-wide block in the card header and in the Alert's actions area. The same applies to the second usage at line 123. Render the wrapper only when the dropdown has content, or move it inside the component.

findings.title: No tests for new repository method, tRPC handler, or dropdown component
findings.body: The PR adds `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` (a groupBy with `_max`), a new `deleteCache` mutation with an ownership check, the `cacheUpdatedAt` enrichment in `connectedCalendarsHandler`, and a component with conditional rendering. None of these has a unit or integration test. The ownership check in `deleteCacheHandler` and the empty-result and negative-credential-ID cases in the enrichment are the most important to cover.
